snippet.title: Monastery: Ora et Labora - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179120/Monastery_Ora_et_Labora?utm_source=youtube
Wishlist Now on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/monastery-ora-et-labora-12fabc
